$description: Gauge (platform/charts/Gauge.jsx, gauge.css; library wave 9, lane A): its component tokens. The fill is the first categorical data-viz color and the threshold bands the data-viz alert scale (data-plx-dataviz); everything else is an existing role.

gauge-width-sm.$description: Gauge: the dial's width at size sm (a card).

gauge-width-md.$description: Gauge: the dial's width at size md (the default).

gauge-width-lg.$description: Gauge: the dial's width at size lg.

gauge-gap.$description: Gauge: the space between the dial, the range and the status badge.

gauge-track-color.$description: Gauge: the track (the whole range) behind the fill.

gauge-track-width.$description: Gauge: the thickness of the track and the fill, in the dial's units (it scales with the size).

gauge-band-width.$description: Gauge: the thickness of a threshold's range outside the track.

gauge-value-text.$description: Gauge: the value in the middle of the dial.

gauge-value-font-family.$description: Gauge: the value is a technical value: the data font (DM Mono).

gauge-value-font-size.$description: Gauge: the value's size (the metric's large value).

gauge-label-text.$description: Gauge: the words under the value (its unit or whole).

gauge-end-text.$description: Gauge: the minimum and maximum under the ends of the arc.

gauge-end-font-family.$description: Gauge: the ends are technical values: the data font.

gauge-end-font-size.$description: Gauge: the ends' size (the tick labels' size).

gauge-end-inset.$description: Gauge: how far in from the dial's sides the ends sit, under the ends of the track.
